statement: The drag area does not depend on the mesh: three meshes converge, and the mesh error band (GCI) of the finest is at most 5%

mechanism.how: aero.mesh_independence: three meshes, each block 1.5 times finer, each meshed, guarded and solved; Celik et al. 2008's GCI on the drag area. Until it is in the pack, no evaluator covers this claim. Measured on the tutorial's own ladder (2026-10-23): 0.3075, 0.2964 and 0.3007 m^2, a drag area that does not converge in one direction
